# Chromium Specialist Checklists

Load only the sections activated by deterministic inventory triggers or the
soft-likelihood routing contract. Treat
these as discovery supplements: record every anomaly as a ledger candidate and
leave severity/disposition to verification. Close a row clean only with a
`path:line` citation to the relevant guard, owner, bound, metadata, or test.

## In-Tree Experimental Code Review (ICRR / ICR)

When `profile.json` records `internal_code_review.available: true` (a
`src-internal` Chromium checkout containing
`internal/agents/skills/experimental-code-review`), Phase 4 runs a two-stage
subagent pipeline alongside the initial generalist and hard-triggered specialist
threads:

- **Stage 1 (`ICRR` — In-Tree Code Review Runner, deliverable `<review-dir>/internal-review-raw.md`):**
  1. Read `<review-dir>/internal-review-capabilities.md` (generated by
     `scripts/resolve-internal-review-capabilities.py`), which resolves the
     main checkout path, `internal/agents/skills/experimental-code-review/SKILL.md`,
     its 7 category checklists (`correctness.md`, `safety.md`, `security.md`,
     `performance.md`, `UX.md`, `accessibility.md`, `testing.md`), all
     content-matched and directory-matched `DIR_METADATA` / `COMMON_METADATA`
     `agentic_review` rules and domain skills in full, and a compact summary
     index of path-matched general rules under
     `agents/knowledge_base/rules/general/`.
  2. Read `<review-dir>/packets/ICR-code.md` first, then inspect any additional
     files in the pinned `<worktree>` using explicit two-dot
     `git -C <worktree> diff <parent-sha> <sha>` (never `origin/main...HEAD`).
  3. If `pndMcp` (`history_rag_query_topics` / `history_rag_get_topic_data`) is
     available in the subagent toolset, execute Phase 2.5 historical RAG lookup
     for the modified subsystem; otherwise continue without blocking.
  4. Execute Phases 3, 4, and 5 of `experimental-code-review/SKILL.md` against
     the pinned diff and write the complete native report (`## Evaluated
     Capability Groups And Rules` plus `## Findings` with `[P0]`, `[P1]`,
     `[P2]`, and `[Suggestion]` items, `File: path:line`, `Rule: rule-id` when
     triggered by an in-tree rule, rationale, and concrete fix) to
     `<review-dir>/internal-review-raw.md`.

- **Stage 2 (`ICR` — In-Tree Code Review Wrapper, roster entry `"In-Tree Code Review"`, `depends_on: ICRR:1`, deliverable `<review-dir>/ledger/ICR.md`):**
  1. Read `<review-dir>/internal-review-raw.md`,
     `<review-dir>/internal-review-capabilities.md`,
     `<review-dir>/packets/ICR-code.md`, and `<review-dir>/indexes/inventory.tsv`.
  2. Write `## Compliance matrix` in `<review-dir>/ledger/ICR.md` with one row
     per evaluated `experimental-code-review` category (`Correctness`, `Safety`,
     `Security`, `Performance`, `UX`, `Accessibility`, `Testing`) and each
     high-signal triggered rule/skill from `internal-review-capabilities.md`,
     each answered with concrete repo-relative `path:line` evidence from the
     pinned worktree.
  3. Convert every finding in `<review-dir>/internal-review-raw.md` (including
     `[P0]`, `[P1]`, `[P2]`, and `[Suggestion]` items — discovery enumerates
     without filtering) into a canonical `## Candidate rows` entry (`ICR-1`,
     `ICR-2`, ...) and a matching `## Candidate descriptors` row in
     `<review-dir>/ledger/ICR.md`.
  4. Verify every cited file path, line number, and symbol against the pinned
     `<worktree>` and `packets/ICR-code.md`. Map `surface` to the matching
     surface ID in `indexes/inventory.tsv` when applicable, preserve any
     in-tree `Rule: <rule-id>` citation in `claim`/`evidence`, and include
     `style-convention` / `style-authority` in `Candidate descriptors` when
     backed by an authoritative in-tree rule. Leave the candidate `severity`
     column blank for Phase 6 synthesis.
